## Storyboard → render

`POST /webhook/render` with a storyboard JSON body.

Flow: validate → plan → render → verify. Every step shells out to the same Python CLI the GitHub Action uses, so there is exactly one implementation of the pipeline.

**Why `--limit` exists:** wire it to a smoke run (`{"limit": 1}`) when you change prompts or a ComfyUI graph; full renders are for the GPU box.

**Resume is automatic:** the SQLite state DB lives in the project folder, so re-running the same webhook continues from the first unfinished scene instead of re-billing for finished ones.

nodes.name: Render (resumable)
nodes.notes: Long-running: keep the n8n EXECUTIONS_TIMEOUT above your slowest scene (default is 3600s).

meta.description: Webhook that validates a storyboard and drives the CLI render + verify gate. Part of Agent-Best---Ai-for-Automation.
